Divaśyenīhautra

Divaśyenīhautraprayoga
śr. Adyar I. p. 66b.

Divasagaṇānayanavidhi

Divasacaramabhavacaramapratyākhyāna
Jain. See BORI. D. XVII. iii. p.. 139. 140.

Divasacarimapratyākhyāna(divasacariyapaccakkhāṇa)
Jain. Pkt. BORI. 1220 (38) of 1884-87. BORI. D. XVII. iii. 941. [Page043-b]

Divasanuṃmāpakāḍhavānīritī_(?)
Jain. Chani 2742.

Divaspatisaṅgraha
dh. mentioned by Jīmūtavāhana in his Kālaviveka. See Kane, HDS. I. p. 564a.

Divākara
of Śāṇḍilyagotra; father of Nayaśarman; an. grandfather of Devadatta an. great grandfather of Bhavadatta or ºdeva (a. of C. Sārasarasvatī on Naiṣadhacarita. IO. 3830-31).

Divākara
of Śrīvatsagotra; of Jambūsaronagara; father of Govardhana an. grandfather of Gaṅgādhara (a. of C. Gaṇitāmṛtasāgarī or Amṛtasāgarī on Līlāvatī, IO. 2806-7. L. 1254; composed in 1420 A. D.).

Divākara
father of Bhāskarācarya, a. elder contemporary of Abhinavagupta an. a. of Kakṣyāstotra, Vivekāñjana an. Śivasūtravārttika (Report CLXVIII). See also Pandey, Abhinavagupta (1963) p. 159.

Divākara
son of Ḍhuṇḍhi of Bhāradvājakula; an. brother of Śiva Jyotirvid (a. of Jātakamuktāvalīpaddhati, IO. 3080).

Divākara
15th Cent.; of Golagrāma on Godāvarī; of Bhāradvājagotra; son of Bhaṭṭācārya; father of Kṛṣṇa; Viṣṇu, Mallārī (a. of C. on Grahalāghava, NCC. VI. p. 259b); Keśava an. Viśvanātha (a. of C. on Jātakapaddhati etc.) an. grandfather of Nṛsim3ha Daivajña (son of Kṛṣṇa) (a. of C. on Sūryasiddhānta, IO. 2778 etc.) an. Śiva (a. of Muhūrtacūḍāmaṇi, TD. 11561) an. great grandfather of Divākara an. Kamalākara (a. of Siddhāntatattvaviveka, IO. 2890-91).
See S. B. Dikshit, Bhāratīya Jyotiṣ (Hindi edn.) p. 383 ff.

Divākara
teacher of Śāradātanaya ref. to in Bhāvaprakāśa. GOS. 45. p. 2. 11. 13-14.
See also ibid. Intro. p. 10.

Divākara
teacher of Rāma (a. of Somapaddhati. śr. C.. I. 329).

Divākara
--Kuṇḍārka. CPB. 938. [Page044-b]

Divākara
--Kṣetrasādhana. jy. PUL. II. p. 213.

Divākara
--Grahayajñadīpa. śr. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1918-30, p. 7 (no. 55).

Divākara
--Tithinirṇaya. dh. Rajapur 433. Ujjain I. p. 27. Ujjain Latest Additions 316 (a..

Divākara
--Parvaprabodha. jy. Bhau Dāji 138.

Divākara
pupil of Narahari.
--C. Arthadīpti on Bodhasāra. vedānta. composed in 1816 A. D. Trav. Uni. 7563 A-B.
Pt.. Ben. Skt. Ser. 23, 1906.

Divākara
--Bodhāyanagṛhyaprayogakārikā (pitṛmedha). PUL. II. App. p. 33.

Divākara
--C. Vyākhyā on Bhūmikābhedabhāskara yoga. of Narahari. Baroda 11014.

Divākara
--Ratnamālā. jy. RASB. 7937.

Divākara
alias Kavicandrarāya or ºācārya; protege of King Kṛṣṇadevarāya an. Gajapati Puruṣottama of Orissa. See NCC. III. p. 274b.
Addl. works:
--Abhinavagītagovinda. See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 300a.
--Devīstuti. in 100 verses mentioned in his Bhāratāmṛtakāvya. Hpr. IV. 198.
--Dhūrtacaritra. bhāṇa. mentioned in his Bhāratāmṛta kāvya.
See RASB. VII. 5181 an. Poona Ori. V. p.. 16-19.
--Rasamañjarī. a collection of verses mentioned in his Bhāratāmṛtakāvyaibid. [Page045-a.

Divākara
son an. pupil of Viśveśvara; grandson of Nārāyaṇa; an. younger brother of Viṣṇu; patronized by a Rāghava.
--Amogharāghava. campū. MT. 4328. See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 359a.

Divākara
son of Bhāradvāja Mahādeva Bhaṭṭa.
--Ācārārka. IM. 4855 (inc.). 4856 (inc.). Weber 1027.

Divākara
son of Īśvara Vidyāvilāsa.
--C. on Ghaṭakarpara. RASB. VII. 5035.
See Pandey, Abhinavagupta (1963) p.. 95-99, 101.

Divākara
alias Dakṣiṇāmūrtinātha of Bhāradvājagotra; son of Gopālakṛṣṇa an. Lakṣmī, an. disciple of Cidambarasvāmin.
--Tripurārcanapaddhati. MT. 622 (b). 6487.

Divākara
son of Dinakara (?).
--Dānadinakara. K. 180.

Divākara
--Lakṣaṇādarśa. kāvya on story of Mahābhārata illustrating points of grammar. MT. 3826 (inc.).

Divākara
of Coladeśa; son of Udbāhusundara, patronized by Mānaveda, Zamorin of Calicut.
--Lakṣmīmānaveda. drama on the marriage of Lakṣmī with Mānaveda, Zamorin of Calicut. MT. 4319.
See Contribution of Kerala to Skt. Lit. p. 112.

Divākara
or Dinakara.
--Śāntisāra. dh. Rajapur 349 (inc.).
See Dinakara Bhaṭṭa above.

Divākara
pupil of Cidambarabrahmayati; belonged to Bhāradvājagotra.
--C. Cidambaradīpikā on Śivamahimnasstava or Śikhariṇīmālā. [Page045-b]
Adyar I. p. 195b (Śivastotra). Adyar D. IV. 1019. Extr. p. 166.

Divākara
--Satpaddhati. jy. PUL. II. p. 238.
C.. Divākarapaddhati.

Divākara(bhaṭṭa)
of Varendra brahmin family; father of Kullūka Bhaṭṭa (a. of C. on Manusmṛti. Pt.. N. S. Press, Bombay, 1909).

Divākara(bhaṭṭa)
of Banaras; belonged to Bhāradvājagotra; father of Rāma Bhaṭṭa (a. of Mantramārtaṇḍa, ref. to by his son) an. grandfather of Bālambhaṭṭa (a. of Vaṭukārcanasaṅgraha, tantra. PUL. I. p. 123. RASB. VIII. B. 6466). [Page044-a.

Divākara(bhaṭṭa)
son of Rāmakṛṣṇa. See Dinakara.

Divākara(paṇḍita)
father of Lo (Ro)limbarāja (a. of Upāṅgalalitāpūjākalpa, Trav. Uni. 2031; Camatkāracintāmaṇi, NCC. VI. p. 386a; an. Vaidyajīvana, Bomb. Uni. 232. IO. 2685).

Divākara(datta)
poet. Padyāvalī 135; Skm. p. 38 (Divākaradatta) (Lahore edn.). verse 254 (Calcutta edn.).
C.. Gotithīyadivākara, NCC. VI. p. 118a, an. Yuvarājadivākara, Skm. p. 89 (Lahore edn.).

Divākara_Upādhyāya
styled a. Jagadguru; protege of a king of Mithilā.
--C. on Kumārasambhava.
--C. Vidyota or Dyotikā on Meghadūta. Hpr. III. 237. IO. 3780. Mithilā II. 110. refers to Śṛ. Pra. an. Sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇa. See V. Raghavan, Bhoja's Śṛṅgāra Prakāśa (1963) p.. 698-99.
--C. on Raghuvam3śa. Composed in 1385 A. D.
See Annals of Ori. Res., Uni. of Madras XIII. p.. 58-59.

Divākarakathā
Jain. Pkt. Chani 1824. Pattan I. p. 13.

Divākarakīrti
--Kṛṣṇayamārināmasādhana. Bud. Cordier II. p. 161.

Divākaracandra
belonged to Bengal according to Bstan; hgyur; a disciple of Maitrī-p. according to Sumpā Mkhan-p.; lived during the reign of Nayapāla; translated 2 works into Tibetan. See Buddhist Tantric Literature of Bengal, NIA. I. p. 11.
--Herukabhūtanāmamaṇḍalopāyikā. Cordier II. p. 83.

Divākaracandra
--Cittaviśuddhi. JBORS. XXI. i. p. 38.
--Nairātmyasādhana. ibid. p. 40.
--Paramagambhīrottamakrama. ibid. p. 39.
--Hevajrabalividhi. ibid. p. 38.
--Hevajrasattvavikāsa. ibid.
--Hevajrasādhanajñānapradīpa. ibid. [Page046-a.

Divākaradatta
poet. Skm. See Divākara.

Divākaradīkṣita
--Dharmamīmām3sātaraṇi. SBBD. 270.

Divākaradaivajña_(Sāṃvatsarācārya)
jy. writer an. scholar in grammar, logic an. literature; of Golagrāma near Devagiri (Dowlatabad); born in 1606 A. D. great grandson of Divākara; grandson of Kṛṣṇa; son of Nṛsim3ha Daivajña an. pupil of his paternal uncle Śiva; elder brother of Kamalākara (a. of Siddhāntatattvaviveka, IO. 2890-91) an. Raṅganātha (a. of C. Mitabhāṣiṇī on Siddhāntaśiromaṇi).
For works q. by him in his C. on Keśava's Jātakapaddhati see Aufrecht, ZDMG. 45 (1891) 303-4; on the a. an. his works (dates of composition) see S. B. Dikshit, Bhāratīya Jyotiṣ (Hindi edn.) p.. 385. 393-4.
--Gaṇitāmṛtasāraṇī. Oudh XX. 122.
--Gopīrājamatakhaṇḍana. Mentioned in his C. on Jātakapaddhati. See ZDMG. 45 (1891) p. 303.
--Janmapaddhati or Jātakapaddhati an. C. Gaṇitatattvacintāmaṇi on it. See NCC. VII. p. 219b.
Addl. mss.: B. IV. 140. BORI. 146 of Ā883-84. Dāhilakṣmī XXXIII. 34 (2 mss.). Khn. 90. NP. I. 80. Peters. II. p. 192 (no. 146).
--C. Prakāśa on Jātakakarmapaddhati of Śrīpati; probably Janipaddhatiprakāśa (Adyar II. p. 56a) an. Janmapaddhatiprakāśa (Mithilā. Oxf. II. 1573) are same a. this.
See NCC. VII. p.. 153b. 156a an. 212b. [Page046-b]
--C. Prauḍhamanoramā on Jātakapaddhati of Keśava (1627 A. D.).
See NCC. VII. p. 218.
--Jātakamārgapadma (paddhatiprakāśa) or Padmajātaka in 104 verses composed a. the age of 19. Ben. 32. Bikaner 4640. IM. 1171.
--Paddhatibhūṣaṇa or Varṣagaṇitapaddhatibhūṣaṇa or Varṣatantra. in 69 verses in Rathoddhatā metre. on astronomical calculations. BBRAS. 314. BORI. 518 of 1892-95. Khn. 92. Skt. Col.. Ben. p. 33 (no. 1107). Weber 874.
--C. on Tithyādipatra of Makaranda; popularly known a. Makarandavivaraṇa or Makarandodāharaṇa or ºkārikā. IM. 1073. IO. 2956. L. 1301. RASB. X. A. 6893. 6897. Weber 864.
The following are probably his works:
--C. on Pātasāriṇī or ºsādhana of Gaṇeśa. PUL. II. p. 225.
--Rāmavinodaprakāśapaddhati. jy. Oudh XX. 118.
--Varṣagaṇitapaddhatibhūṣaṇa. IM. 1315.
--Varṣaphalapaddhati. jy. K. 240.
--Divākarī. Oudh VII. 14.
--C. Mañjubhāṣiṇī. Oudh VIII. 4.

Divākaradvivedārya
or Divākarārddhi of Naidhruvakāśyapagotra; father of Nārāyaṇa (a. of C. on Āśvalāyanagṛhyasūtra, IO. 4552. TD. 11758).
See NCC. II. p. 219b.

Divākarapaddhati
or Divākarīyapaddhati. jy. by Divākara. AK. 867. America 4719. BORI. 867 of 1891-95. Oppert II. 1972.
C.. Jātakapaddhati, NCC. VII. p. 219b an. Paddhatibhūṣaṇa below. [Page047-a.

Divākarapaddhatiprakāśavivaraṇa
by Vīreśvara, son of Gopāla. BORI. 88 of Ā882-83. This is C.. on Divākara's C. on Śrīpati's Jātakakarmapaddhati. See NCC. VII. p. 212b.

Divākarapuruṣottama
patron of Kṛṣṇadatta (a. of Purañjanacarita, L. 2000).

Divākarabhaṭṭa
--Triveṇīpaddhati. dh. Baroda 5840.

Divākarabhaṭṭa
son of Kṛṣṇa Bhaṭṭa.
--Nirṇayasindhu. Harshe. p. 45.

Divākarabhaṭṭa
--Śrāddhaprayoga for Āśval. dh. Baroda 8768.

Divākarabhaṭṭa
teacher of Sujanabhaṭṭa (a. of Śabdaliṅgārthacandrikā).
--Sarvārthaśikhāmaṇi. mentioned by Cakorabhaṭṭācārya, in his C. Śarat on Dṛṣṭāntasiddhāñjana. Adyar D. VI. 812.

Divākarabhaṭṭa
latter part of 17th Cent.; devotee of Sūrya; son of Mahādeva Bhaṭṭa an. grandson of Bālakṛṣṇa Bhaṭṭa of Bhāradvājagotra; his mother was the daughter of Nīlakaṇṭha Bhaṭṭa, son of Śaṅkara Bhaṭṭa an. grandson of Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa (who founded Avimukta Viśveśvara); father of Vaidyanātha (a. of anukramaṇīs to several works of his father. See Kane, HDS. I. p. 746a).
For his genealogy see IO. 1708. J. Bomb. Uni. New Ser. XI. ii. p. 89 an. Kane, HDS. I. p. 702b.
--Dharmaśāstrasudhānidhi. Composed in 1683 A. D. Hall p.. 175. 176.
The following may be parts of this work.
--Antyeṣṭiprakāśa. Hpr. III. 5.
--Antyeṣṭiprayogaprakāśa. PUL. I. p. 77 (part of his Dānahīrāvalīprakāśa). [Page047-b]
--Ācārārka. See NCC. II. p. 33.
--Tithyarka (prakāśa). See NCC. VIII. p. 177.
--Dānahīrāvalīprakāśa. Baroda 11044. IO. 1708. Ujjain Latest Additions 618. See above p. 13b.
--Pañcāyatanapratiṣṭhāpaddhati. Baroda 8323. 10923. 11083.
See Sūryādipañcāyatanapratiṣṭhāpaddhati below.
--Prāyaścittamuktāvalī. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 74. Baroda 1483. BORI. 249 of 1886-92. CPB. 3240. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1897-1901, p. 52 (no. 172).
--Śrāddhacandrikā. Bomb. Uni. 1172. Ujjain Latest Additions 222.
--Sūryaprastāva. Q. in his C. on Vṛttaratnākara. IO. 1095.
--Sūryādipañcāyatanapratiṣṭhāpaddhati. BORI. 160 of 1892-95. L. 711. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1897-1901, p. 55 (no. 183). Trav. Uni. 4853. Sūryādipratimāpratiṣṭhāpaddhati, NP. V. 46 is probably same a. this.
His other works:
--Prācīnapadyāvalī. kāvya. Trav. Uni. 1770. 7073.
--Mantramārtaṇḍa. Q. in his Ācārārka, Aufrecht I. p. 254a.
--C. Ādarśa on Vṛttaratnākara of Kedāra. Bikaner 5544. IO. 1095. RASB. VI. 4763.
Q. by Mallinātha in his C. on Śiśupālavadha I, 2.

Divākarabhaṭṭa_Kāle
C. 1620-70 A. D. son of Mahādeva an. daughter's son of Rāmakṛṣṇa Bhaṭṭa; father of Kamalākara (a. of Nirṇayasindhu, Bomb. Uni. 1207). See Kane, HDS. I. p. 703a.
--Āhnika or Āhnikacandrikā or [Page048-a. Sam3kṣepāhnikacandrikā. Pt.. See NCC. II. p. 238b. The references to Āhnika in NCC. II. p. 236b are probably same a. this.
--Kālanirṇayacandrikā. See NCC. IV. p. 28a.
--Dānacandrikā or Dānasaṅkṣepacandrikā. BBRAS. 690. IO. 1709-11. L. 5. Oxf. II. 1494. TD. 18878.
See above p. 5b.
--Tulāpuruṣadānaprayoga, from above. Mithilā.
--Patitatyāgavidhi. dh. Ben. 147.
--Punarupanayanaprayoga. Ben. 147.
--Prāyaścittacandrikā. Khn. 76. Same a. his Smārtaprāyaścittoddhāra ?.
--Saptapākasam3sthā(vidhi). Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 125. RASB. II. 379. Ujjain Latest Additions 273.
--Smārtaprāyaścittāni or ºprāyaścittoddhārapaddhati. BBRAS. 745. IM. 1802 (inc.). 2581. L. 901. TD. 13151.
--Nityanaimittikaprāyaścittakārikā. Ujjain I. p. 15 (Same a. above ?)

Divākarabhaṭṭāraka
--C. Vṛtti in Skt. an. Kannada on Tattvārthasūtra of Umāsvāmi. Hombucca 46. Moodbidri II. 785. Waranga 61.

Divākaravajra
or Sūryavajra.
--Caṇḍamahāroṣaṇavajrapāṇihomavidhi. Bud. Cordier II. p. 329.
--Nīlāmbaradharavajrapāṇisādhanacintāmaṇināma. ibid. p. 328.

Divākaravatsa
Q. by Abhinavagupta in Īśvarapratyabhijñāvimarśinī. Same a. Bhāskarācārya (son of Divākara), a. elder contemporary of Abhinavagupta [Page048-b] an. a. of Kakṣyāmālāstotra etc. See Pandey, Abhinavagupta (1963) p. 159.

Divākarasūri
son of Mahādevasūri of Bhāradvājakula.
--Śatacaṇḍyādipradīpa. tantra. RASB. VIII. A. 6407.

Divākarācārya
--Candrārkīsūtra. jy. Bikaner 4566. IM. 1152.
See Dinakara Bhaṭṭa of Moḍha family above.

Divākarācārya
--Praśnakaumudī. jy. Ani.

Divākarācārya
--C. on Prākṛtapiṅgala. Dacca 3265.

Divākarāṣṭaka
stotra. Trav. Uni. 5790Z-25. 10659G.

Divākarī
ny. Mandlik p. 53, BE. 9 (fr.).

Divākarīpaddhati
unspecified. Lucknow Mus.
C.. Divākarapaddhati above.

Divākarodyota
See Dinakaroddyota. Q. in Dravyaśuddhidīpikā. Oxf. 274a.

Divājātāśvaśānti
dh. MD. 3334. 17760.
C.. Divāśvajananaśānti below.

Divānakṣatrādidarśanaśānti
spoken by Saptarṣis. MD. 3335.

Divānacandramiśra
resident of Lavapura. authority on jy. father of Rādhākṛṣṇa (a. of Praśnākṣara or Praśnākṣaraślokasamanvaya. Bomb. Uni. 524). Sarvārthacintāmaṇi of Veṅkaṭeśa is wrongly ascribed to him by Aufrecht. See Stein 175.

Divānandīya
ny. by Divānanda. Oppert II. 2829.

Divāmuhūrtalakṣaṇa
jy. a.. TD. 11702.

Divārāma
--Ramalabhāskara. IM. 9470 (inc.). [Page049-a.

Divāli(lī)kalpa
Jain. BP. p.. 221b. 229a (2 mss.). See Dīpā(v.)līkalpa.

Divāśvajananaśānti
p.. Adyar I. p. 97a.
C.. Divājātāśvaśānti above.

Divirakiśoraka
poet. Śp. 574. See also Kiśoraka, NCC. IV. p. 165b.

Divodāsa
writer on dh.; earlier than 1550 A. D. Q. in Tithinirṇaya a.. Lz. 547; by Nāgoji Bhaṭṭa in Tīrthenduśekhara, RASB. III. 2444; by Divākara in Kālanirṇayacandrikā (Kane, HDS. I. p. 703a); by Dhanvantari in Sannipātakalikā, Mu7nchen J. 396.; by Suśruta.

Divodāsaprakāśa

Lz. 499; by Bhaṭṭoji Dīkṣita in Tristhalīnirṇayasaṅkṣepa, Lz. 548; in Nirṇayasindhu p.. 65-66, 80, 166 etc. (Chowk. edn. 1930); by Ananta Bhaṭṭa in Vidhānapārijāta, IO. 1469. 1470.
See also Kane, HDS. I. p.. 564a an. 703a.

Divyakaṣaḍāricakra
Arrah I. A. p. 43 (Pt..).

Divyakairalī
See Keralapraśna an. Divyacūḍāmaṇi of Keralācārya. Assam J.. 16.

Divyacakṣus

Divyacāpavijayacampū
by Cakravarti Veṅkaṭācārya, son of Śrīśailavarya an. disciple of his grandfather. MD. 12302.

Divyacūḍāmaṇi
jy. by Keralācārya.
See Keralapraśna, NCC. V. p. 44.

Divyatattva
dh. on making oaths (parīkṣā); 18th section of Smṛtitattva; by Raghunandana.
Ani. AS. p. 83 (2 mss.). Assam Smṛti 10. Ben. 135. Cabaton I. 802 (III). C.. II. 163. 558.
